text: Over the last 30 days, visitor feedback has highlighted concerns about the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, with several reviewers feeling it detracts from the educational value and authenticity of the experience. Some visitors also noted poor lighting and inadequate signage, which made navigating the museum difficult. The food service received negative comments regarding quality and wait times. On the positive side, the building’s architecture and interactive exhibits were frequently mentioned, contributing to the overall average rating of 4.7. Attention to exhibit design and visitor amenities could improve the experience.
